blocks.text: CEBU CITY — Instead of letting millions of liters of water go to waste, the local government of Minglanilla town is tapping water refilling stations to help communities cope with a looming drought brought by the projected Super El Niño. Acting Mayor Lheslen Enad of Minglanilla town said the municipal government has partnered with water refilling station operators to turn their establishments into designated barangay water stations, where residents facing shortages can access water for household needs.
